title: Beautiful!
text: Beautiful!. This is a beautiful Georgia shaped cutting board. The detail is laser engraved. It has a hanging tie on it in case you want to use it as a wall decoration. It would really make a good gift!

product_metadata.title: Totally Bamboo Rock & Branch Origins Series South Carolina State Shaped Cutting Board and Charcuterie Serving Tray, Includes Hang Tie for Wall Display
features: Unique South Carolina Shape: Celebrate The Palmetto State with this gorgeously crafted South Carolina shaped acacia wood cutting board; measures 14" x 11-1/2" x 3/5"
Iconic South Carolina Artwork: Board is boldly laser engraved with the state name and homage to the crescent and palmetto tree
A Fun Charcuterie Board: Show off your love for South Carolina while serving a delicious grazing board meats, cheeses, fruit and more to friends and family
Wonderful as Wall Decor: The included hang tie makes it easy for the board to double as wall art; show off your love of South Carolina by hanging it in the kitchen, dining room, den or office
Give the Gift of Home: Makes an outstanding gift for anyone who loves South Carolina; perfect for birthdays, housewarmings, weddings, Christmas or any holiday occasion
